settings.headline:
Therapy that meets you
where you are.
settings.copy: Stillpoint is a mental wellness practice built around one idea: you don't have to figure this out alone. Our licensed therapists offer a calm, judgement-free space to explore what's weighing on you — whether that's anxiety, burnout, a difficult relationship, or simply feeling stuck.

settings.title: Care shaped around
settings.intro: No two people arrive the same way, so no two care plans should either. Our therapists specialise in a range of modalities and work with you to find what fits — not a one-size-fits-all script.

features.title: Individual therapy
features.text: One-on-one sessions for anxiety, depression, burnout, grief, and life transitions. We start where you are and build a plan around your goals and pace.

features.title: Couples & relationship counselling
features.text: A structured, compassionate space to untangle conflict, rebuild trust, and communicate better — whether you're in crisis or just want to grow stronger together.

features.title: Trauma-informed care
features.text: Specialised support for people living with the after-effects of trauma. Grounding, evidence-based approaches delivered slowly, at a pace you control.

features.title: Group support
features.text: Small, facilitated groups for anxiety, grief, new parents, and burnout recovery. Connection with people who genuinely get it — in a safe, confidential setting.

features.title: Teletherapy
features.text: The same licensed therapists, over a secure video link. If you can't make it to an office, care comes to you — from anywhere in the state.

features.title: Workshops & workplace care
features.text: Resilience workshops, mental-health days, and employee support programs for teams and organisations that want to invest in wellbeing at scale.

settings.title: A path, not a
settings.intro: Whatever brings you in, the shape of the work is the same: we listen first, agree on where you want to get to, and walk alongside you at a pace that feels right.

design.title: Get to know you
design.text: We start with a free intro call, then a full first session where your therapist learns your history, goals, and what 'better' looks like for you.

build.title: Regular sessions
build.text: Weekly or bi-weekly sessions using a mix of approaches — CBT, EMDR, mindfulness, and narrative work — tailored to what's actually showing up in your life.

launch.title: A plan you sustain
launch.text: As you make progress, we agree on how to sustain it: tapering sessions, booster check-ins, or a referral onward. We never leave you without a plan.

settings.title: Starting care,
settings.intro: Reaching out is often the hardest step. We've made the rest as simple as possible.

steps.title: Book a free intro call
steps.text: A 20-minute conversation, no commitment. Tell us a little about what's going on and ask us anything. We'll recommend a therapist and next steps.

steps.title: Meet your therapist
steps.text: We match you with a therapist who fits your needs and preferences. If the first match isn't right, we'll try again until it feels right.

steps.title: Begin regular sessions
steps.text: Start meeting weekly or bi-weekly. Together you set goals and a rhythm, and adapt as life changes around you.

steps.title: Build lasting wellbeing
steps.text: Work at your pace toward the tools and insights that last. When you're ready, we agree on a plan to sustain your progress beyond therapy.

settings.note: Most clients notice a difference within 6–12 sessions, and we review progress together every month so you always know where things stand.

settings.title: Words from

settings.title: Questions new
settings.intro: The honest answers to the questions we hear most often before someone books their first session.

items.question: Do you take insurance?
items.answer: Yes. We accept most major insurance plans and offer sliding-scale fees for clients who qualify. Our team checks your coverage before your first session so there are no surprises.

items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answer: Individual sessions range from $130–$180 depending on therapist and length. We have a limited number of sliding-scale slots, and the free intro call is always no-cost and no-obligation.

items.question: How quickly can I get an appointment?
items.answer: For most new clients, we can schedule a first session within one to two weeks. Teletherapy often has openings sooner. If you're in crisis, we'll help connect you to immediate support.

items.question: Is online therapy as effective as in-person?
items.answer: For many people, yes. Research shows online therapy is highly effective for anxiety, depression, and relationship work. Some clients prefer it — you can switch between in-person and online whenever you like.

settings.title: Take the first step
settings.intro: Book a free 20-minute intro call or send us a message. A real person — not a bot — will get back to you within one business day.
